workflow: Manual data entry from Salesforce to QuickBooks for invoicing and revenue reconciliation
current_workaround: Sales ops team manually exports opportunity data from Salesforce, formats it in Excel, then imports into QuickBooks; also manually reconciles discrepancies weekly
consequence: Billing delays, errors in revenue recognition, wasted 2-3 hours daily, missed opportunities due to stale data

workflow: Spreadsheet-based inventory reconciliation between Shopify and warehouse management system
current_workaround: Download inventory reports from Shopify and WMS, paste into Google Sheets, manually compare SKU counts, flag discrepancies
consequence: Stockouts, overselling, manual error risk, 4-5 hours every Monday, delayed fulfillment

workflow: Manual report generation from multiple analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, HubSpot) for monthly executive reporting
current_workaround: Log into each tool, export PDFs/CSVs, copy key metrics into a PowerPoint deck, spend 2 days compiling
consequence: Stale data by the time report is shared, staff burnout, inconsistent metrics, delayed decision-making

workflow: Manual ticket assignment to support agents based on skill and workload
current_workaround: Team lead manually reviews each ticket, reads context, assigns to the right agent via dropdown in the ticketing system
consequence: Slow response times, misassigned tickets, team lead becomes bottleneck, agents spend 15-20 mins daily reassigning misfiled tickets

workflow: Manual collection of evidence for SOC 2 Type II audit controls
current_workaround: Compliance team emails various department heads for screenshots, logs, and policy acknowledgments; stores everything in a shared drive folder with manual versioning
consequence: Missed evidence deadlines, audit findings, consultant fees ($10k+), risk of non-compliance, 2 weeks of frantic effort per quarter
